consequence.statement: Promoting an existing installation to 0.16.0 fails when the CRD update is rejected with 'spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook'; the release notes say to use 0.16.1 as opposed to 0.16.0 on the installation path.
consequence.remediation: Upgrade with the 0.16.1 chart instead of 0.16.0.

assertion.statement: The 0.16.0 chart removes spec.conversion (strategy Webhook pointing at the external-secrets-webhook /convert service) from the external-secrets CRDs, so promoting an existing installation to 0.16.0 can have the CRD update rejected with 'spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook'; the release notes say to use 0.16.1 instead of 0.16.0.
